notes.title: [Notice] Transaction Restriction System Changes (08/07/25)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/d0f343240d222afcf346c478d79025ad8d836f7d.jpg"]

Hello! This is an announcement from Soulworker.

We would like to inform you of the changes made to the following item-related restrictions for accounts, which were applied in March and May 2025.

Affected Features:
- Trade (1:1 Transaction)
- Mail (H.E.M.S)
- Market
- League Storage

### Restriction Changes

- Before Update:
※ You can view the previously implemented transaction restrictions in the announcement below:

[Notice] Transaction Restriction System Changes (05/15/25)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/e72f5c83e0e7a918a48e45f4715ceaa05a522974.jpg"]

- After the Update:
※ The following features require the character to be Level 85:
  - 1:1 Trading
  - Mail (H.E.M.S)
  - Market

※ The features listed below will be restricted for 30 days after an account's first Cash Shop purchase:
  - This applies to:
    - Accounts created after the August 7 update
    - Accounts created before August 7 that have never made a Cash Shop purchase

    Restricted features:
    - 1:1 Trading
    - Mail (H.E.M.S)
    - Market
    - League Storage

Note:
- If your 30-day restriction is still active, you may not be able to wrap costumes.
- The 30-day countdown will now be displayed on your Profile menu.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/5c894763ebadcf89e036252078fbd7747537a060.png"]

### Amendments FAQ

#1

Question:
- I made my first Cash Shop purchase on July 21. Will the 60-day restriction still apply after the August 7 update?

Answer:
- No. Starting August 7, the 60-day restriction will be shortened by 30 days.

Example:
- Before August 7 Policy:
  - Account Created: April 13
  - Purchase Date: July 21
  - Item Restriction: 60-day countdown begins
  - Transaction Restriction: 60-day countdown begins
  - Both restrictions end: September 21

- After August 7 Policy:
  - A 30-day reduction will be applied to the transaction restriction.
  - New Transaction Restriction End Date: August 21

#2

Question:
- What happens to accounts that have already completed the Transaction Policy before the March 2025 update?

Answer:
- If your account already fulfilled the initial transaction requirement (e.g., first Cash Shop purchase completed before March 2025), you will retain full access to the following features without further restrictions:
  - 1:1 Trading
  - Mail (H.E.M.S)
  - Market
  - League Storage

Example:
- An old account that met the first-purchase condition
- Made a Cash Shop purchase by July 10
- After the August 7 update, no transaction restrictions will be displayed on the account

notes.title: [Notice] 24/02/21 Development update of Soulworker
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/757a1b6a05608f23b618095734082db46191f0e0.png

Hello! This is an announcement from SoulWorker.

We would like to inform you about the current development status of SoulWorker.

The transition progress is running smoothly and we plan to complete it by February. Further updates will be released sequentially from March onwards. 

We are also excited to announce some of the content which is currently in progress.

Future Updates:

Content:
- Addition of Hidden Hideout: Heroic Mode, entry-level 82 / number of participants: 1~4 players. 
Once the raid is opened, this content can be participated in indefinitely.
- Golden Maze (Tentative name): Additional content necessary for expanding functions of reinforcement will be scheduled. 
- A new maze will be added at Episode 2.5. With the addition of the new story, the level will be raised to 85 and the Mastery Level will be adjusted too.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/67b2734890713e40be4566b6f99873f93ed50489.png

Future Sale Items:
- [Dhana] The Lord of Dark Forces 

System changes related:
- DirectX 11 Support: We are going to apply updates for DirectX to provide better game optimization. With updates in DirectX 11, gameplay in an improved environment will be applied where several characters and NPCs appear simultaneously. 
※ Depending on the condition of gameplay, there are cases where it may not be possible to experience the effects.
- Skill adjustment: Skill balance will be adjusted for all characters.
- Upgrade: The maximum enhancement value will be increased from +9 to +15.
- Scheduled addition of Mystic Akashic Records [Tenebris]

Regarding the update schedule, we are currently adjusting it, so we will inform everyone once the details are decided.

Furthermore, we will be re-running past in-game events to make it easier for players to strengthen their equipment that can be obtained from the current content until the next update.

Once again, we apologize for keeping everyone waiting. In the future, we will keep you informed of the development status and update the schedule to the extent that it can be disclosed.

Thank you for your cooperation.

[HOW TO CREATE SQUAD]
- Please go to the Raid District, "Operation Stratos" in order to play the "Vile Predator" Raid.
- "Operation Stratos" is used as a waiting area platform where users are able to control number of people, level of Raids, as well as leaving / re-entering the Maze.
- When creating a Squad, said Character will be set as the Squad Leader in which she/he can edit and start Raids.
- ‘Story Playback’ function cannot be activated in "Operation Stratos" district.



[RAID STRUCTURE]
- Mazes in the Vile Predator
> (Sub Maze) Hall of Flames 
> (Sub Maze) Scarlet Madness 
> (Sub Maze) Howling Fang 
> (Main Maze) Evolving Habitation 

- Normal (1 Player Only) / Hard (1~12 Players)
- Not Possible to Use [Active] Akashic Records

- HARD difficulty: 3 Parties
> Team [1]: Max 4 Team Members
> Team [2]: Max 4 Team Members
> Team [3]: Max 4 Team Members
> Sub Parties (Hall of Flames / Scarlet Madness / Howling Fang) → Defeat Flemma / Relfenne / Gale to gain Buffs for Entire Teams & gain Debuffs to weaken Vista
> Main Party (Evolving Habitation) → Try to Defeat Vista
- Each Maze of "Vile Predator" has a Re-Spawn limit of 3 times (Exception: Daily free Re-Spawn, Cash Re-Spawn).

- Squad can consist of at least 1 user and a maximum of 12.
- In order for smooth gameplay in Vile Predator, 12 users are Highly Recommended in a Squad.

◆ 2023 July Update Preview

☞ July First Update (on July 6th)

1.  [EVENT] EPISODE 2 COMING SOON
- For the Second Update of July [Episode 2], we have prepared an Event for all of SoulWorkers!

☞ July Second Update (on July 20th)

1. EPISODE 2 (ACT 1 / ACT 2)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/303d055c6d31ab37fffec47bfff9d3213ddb2d96.png

★ Episode 2 is subtitled "Nowhere to Hide".

Haven Island, a huge island in the East Cloudream.
It was once known as Paradise Island... But now there is no light and no human footprint at all. Heaven? That was a long time ago.
Yes... this is where the Second Story is about to begin; the island with mysterious sounds... and screams.

That's where the SoulWorkers struggle to thwart Vista's demonic plan!


★ Episode 2 [Act 1 / Act 2] Update: July 20th, 2023
★ Episode 2 [Act 3] Update: August 3rd, 2023


1-1. [NEW MAZE] MUTED HAVEN
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/0b5b1bdd5256be34c737665a342df8c6b7f3a7aa.png

▶ Recommended: Lv. 79 or Higher

Highly advanced science is nothing short of magic...
and the precarious earth will eventually die and disappear.
You mortal beings are useless, and time is worthless.
Every life and hope will turn to dust and ashes...
Now Perish.


Heitz and Martin have finally found the location where Vista is believed to be located. No time to hesitate. They immediately called SoulWorkers.

Once known as Paradise Island, Haven Island was rich in trade with Arcadia Realm. But now there is no light and no human footprint. And Heitz told SoulWorkers it's time to begin a manhunt for Vista... right here.

SoulWorkers have finally arrived in Haven Island. A... paradise? The island is completely in ruins.
All of a sudden, the Vacuum Junk appears and attacks SoulWorkers. Something... Something's not right... They realize that bodies are Heavier than usual.

Heitz constantly coughs on her way to the lab. Eventually, she can't stand the pain and falls down.
SoulWorkers decide to leave Haven Island immediately and return to Arcadia Realm... to save her.
After arriving, they visit Sedurin to ask why Heitz is sick.

Sedurin has asked SoulWorkers to go back to Haven Island with her Signal Detector.
They hope this device finds out a certain signal that made Heitz sick and fall.


1-2. [NEW MAZE] CHAMBER ASTRAY

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/7602f27c5d6507fe58d8e24c36a8636e2eefda7c.png

▶ Recommended: Lv. 80 or Higher

Ah yes. Science... It shall fulfill my dream, my ambition... my everything.
Yes, yes! Eat every single life and take all the souls in this pathetic world!
YOU... Make Me Complete!


Heitz was restored to health without any further problems. And SoulWorkers killed all the enemies at the laboratory entrance.
Now's the time for them to enter the lab of Vista. Heitz also called Thomas to the front of the laboratory, and she told him to go into the lab with the SoulWorkers...

No one had a map of the lab. But this place was too big and wide. SoulWorkers and Thomas were afraid they'd miss Vista here...
They were at a loss for how to find their destination. Just then, a mysterious girl appeared in front of them. The girl told them where to go to meet Vista.
And... she suddenly disappeared in a flash.


1-3. [QUEST] STORY FOR EACH CHARACTER

1. Haru Estia

Thomas tried to go to Haven Island to disrupt Vista's experiment. But Haru killed Vista's test subjects a step ahead of Thomas to stop and calm him down.


2. Erwin Arclight

Erwin found Rona looked very tired than usual. He asked Rona if she was okay. Then, she told him that it was because the Coffee Truck failed to arrive due to the attack of Vacuum Junk. Rona also said that C-ration Coffee cannot be defined as coffee. Now, Erwin headed to Haven Island... to find authentic regular coffee.


3. Lily Bloommerchen

A boy didn't give up and kept trying to go to the island to find his parents. Lily promised the boy that she would find his parents instead. Then she headed to Haven Island.


4. Jin Seipatsu

Jin heard there was a unit out of touch on the way back from operations on Haven Island. So, he entered the island to search for them.


5. Stella Unibell

Stella heard a rumor from Rona that a ghost was coming out of Haven Island. She said she would deal with everything related to the ghost and headed for the island.


6. Iris Yuma

Iris heard that Michelle, her mother, suddenly became unconscious with the flu. Sedurin said it could be a Monopuhl Leave Addiction, not the flu. And Rona told Iris about the conspiracy of Congress about Monopuhl Leaves. But the problem was that the existing drugs administered to Michelle... did not work at all. Iris headed to Haven Island to find relevant data.


7. Chii Aruel

Chii tried to find the source of the dog odor coming from somewhere. However, the smell came from various objects. She guessed that this smell may have come from Haven Island.


8. Ephnel

A soldier told Ephnel about his friend who went missing during an operation. He asked her to search the island. Then Ephnel told the soldier she would do the job for 1,000,000 Zenny, and he accepted it.


9. Lee Nabi

Nabi heard rumors from Heitz and Rona that ghosts appear on Haven Island. So, Nabi set off to the island to confirm the truth.


10. Dhana Opini

Dhana wanted to go to Haven Island and find traces of Vista. Heitz accepted her request.



2. MAX LEVEL CHANGE

- Current: Lv.79

- AFTER UPDATE: Lv.81
> Lv.72 Skills will be UNLOCKED.


3. Lv.72 SKILLS: [ IV ]

- Character’s Max Level will be changed from Lv.79 to Lv.81
> Lv.72 Skills’ [ IV ] will also be Unlocked.

☞ May Second Update (on May 18th)

1. LEAGUE UNITE – Main Character + Account Basis

▶ PURPOSE
- Current Situation: Each Character → Each Different League

- Common Problems: 
> Users begin to level up New Character → No League → Hard to level up / ask for help
> All leagues have a Limited Number of members who can join. → Not Possible to let New Characters join the League

- How to Solve / Change
> Current: Join League → Each Character Basis
> After Update: Join League → Account Basis (+Main Character's League)


▶ RECAP
- After Update → Account Basis + Main Character's League
> Your Main Character's League: Remain / Stay
> Your Other Characters' Leagues: Auto-Quit


▶ CHANGES
- League Member Number Limit → Account Basis
- Enable to check Each Member's [Main Character].
- League Login Check: Once a Day (Account Basis)
- League Booster → Account Basis
- League News / Logbook: Written as the [Main Character] of Each Member
- [★★★Please Note★★★] No Main Character Yet? → Not Possible to Join / Create League
- [★★★Please Note★★★] After joining the League → Not Possible to Delete Main Character


★★★ MORE ABOUT [LEAGUE UNITE] UPDATE ★★★

(PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING CAREFULLY before May 18th Update.)

▶ LEAGUE MASTER

1. If Your Main Character = League Master
- League Master Grade will Remain.
- Your Other Characters → Auto-Join Your League

2. Your Character is the League Master → But if this character is Not your Main Character
- This League Master Character is Not your Main Character → Auto-Quit the League
- This League's [Vice Master] Character → Become the League Master
> [★★★Please Note★★★] But!! If this [Vice Master] Character is also Not a Main Character? → Not Possible to be the League Master → The League will be DELETED!!


▶ LEAGUE DELETION

1. About League Deletion
- [★★★Please Note★★★] League Deletion → Every Single Infomation of the League will be Lost and Gone.
- Deleted League → 'League Emblem Change' item can Not be Returned or Recovered or Restored.
- League Deleted by League Unite Update → League NAME can be used AGAIN after May 18th Update.

2. About League Store (When League Deletion)
- League Deleted by League Unite Update → League Store's Each Item:
> [★★★Please Note★★★] Each Item will be returned to the [Last Character] who put the item in the League Store
> How to Return: via H.E.M.S (Account Basis)

- If that [Last Character] is Deleted → the item will be sent to H.E.M.S. (Account Basis)

- Each Item can be received through H.E.M.S within One Year.
> [★★★Please Note★★★] If you don't receive it within 1 year → Not Possible to Return or Recover or Restore.


▶ PARTICULAR SITUATIONS (AFTER LEAGUE UNITE UPDATE)

- Auto-Quit League by League Unite Update → Enable to Join the League after May 18th Update without any penalty

- After League Unite Update (May 18th Update) → Join League → Leave → Penalty (Account Basis): Can't join another League right away

- Ongoing League Raid will be ENDED / CLOSED → After League Unite Update (May 18th Update) → Rewards will be provided.

▶ MORE INFORMATION

- League UI design will be improved.

- Not joined any League yet → Press League button → New Pop-up: Create League / League List
> New Pop-up: Create League / League List → Can also be activated through NPC 'Seres'
> This function can ONLY be used in Districts.


Please look forward to our Upcoming May Update.
Take a walk. Smell a flower. Catch some sun. Play SoulWorker.
But whatever you do, have a Happy May Day!
Thank you so much!

1. HOW TO ENTER
- Must ACCEPT the Quest [Parallel Keeper] from NPC ‘Eo’ in Arcadia Realm
> Then, Parallel Metronome will be unlocked and activated.
> No need to receive or accept [Parallel Keeper] Quest again.

-  Enable to enter Parallel Metronome through NPC [Rona] in Arcadia Realm

2. VALID ENTRY
* FP Consumption per Entry: FP 20
- Parallel Metronome doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Parallel Metronome has a "Valid Entry" limit.

- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit

- The number of valid entries (for NORMAL / HARD) is 9 per week and will be added 2 times when Soul "PLUS" is activated.
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
- No Valid Entry Left means: No Drop or Reward Items can be obtained.
- Valid Entry Limit will be "Reset Mondays at 1 AM (GMT)".
* Not possible to enter with Force state.

- Total Phase: 2
- All Players Dead and No one have 'Respawn': Not possible to obtain rewards.

[ ENTRY REQUIREMENT ]
- Above Lv. 79 can enter.

[ HOW TO ENTER ]
* Must Complete [Whisper of the Beast I / II / III / IV] Quests 
→ Enable to enter Tragic Fairy through NPC [Rona] in Arcadia Realm

[ VALID ENTRY ]
* FP Consumption per Entry: FP 20
- Tragic Fairy doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Tragic Fairy has a "Valid Entry" limit.

- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit

- The number of valid entries (for NORMAL / HARD) is 9 per week and will be added 2 times when Soul "PLUS" is activated.
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
- No Valid Entry Left means: No Drop or Reward Items can be obtained.
- Valid Entry Limit will be "Reset Mondays at 1 AM (GMT)".
* Not possible to enter with Force status.

[ MORE ABOUT TRAGIC FAIRY ]
- Total Phase: 2
- All Players Dead and No one have 'Respawn': Not possible to obtain rewards.

- Respawn Limit:
> Free Respawn - [3] +2 (PLUS)

[How To Enter]
- Can enter through NPC [Arin] in Grace City.

[Number of Valid Entries]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/ec5a6458888a685cc2f17fb763134192dd45584c.jpg

- Broken Savior doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Broken Savior has a "Valid Entry" limit.
- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
- Valid Entry Limit will be Reset Weekly. (Account Base)
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
> 2 ~ 4 Players Party Play: Drop Item Rewards are only available for players with Valid Entries remaining.
> (e.g.) 3 players - A, B, C players
A - Valid Entry: 3 (Can obtain rewards) / B - Valid Entry: 0 (No rewards) / C - Valid Entry: 1 (Can obtain rewards)
- Valid Entry Limit will be "Reset Mondays at 01:00 (GMT)".

- Required "Accuracy": 2,500 or More 
- Respawn Limit:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/df4ee2401a13c8ba67df6284b2edd28796ca90b0.jpg

[How To Enter]
-  Raid for Scenario
> Complete the Main Quest [Overwhelming Power] → Speak to NPC [Toru] → Receive the Quest [How To Cut Off The Monster's Head]
( ※ Haru Estia / Erwin Arclight: Must clear the Quest [Prepare To Cut Off That Monster's Head] first → then, enable to receive the Quest [How To Cut Off The Monster's Head] )
> During the Quest: Use a Warp Item "Operation Order: [Broken Savior]" to enter Broken Savior 'Scenario Raid'.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/15c52d9c1006333872bbafbb3a0878d1991bc239.jpg

[Number of Valid Entries]
- Broken Savior doesn't have any Entry Limit. (e.g. If a player has enough FP, No limit to enter the raid.)
- However, Broken Savior has a "Valid Entry" limit.
- Valid Entry: The actual number that a player can obtain Drop Items if a player clears the raid.
> Fail to clear the Raid within Valid Entry Limit → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
> Leaving in the middle of the Raid → No Reward and Lose 1 chance of Valid Entry Limit
- Valid Entry Limit will be Reset Weekly. (Account Base)
- The number of valid entries is 20 per week and will be added 2 times when Soul "PLUS" is activated.
- When a player enters the raid → the Valid Entry Limit will be immediately deducted.
> 2 ~ 4 Players Party Play: Drop Item Rewards are only available for players with Valid Entries remaining.
> (e.g.) 3 players - A, B, C players
A - Valid Entry: 3 (Can obtain rewards) / B - Valid Entry: 0 (No rewards) / C - Valid Entry: 1 (Can obtain rewards)

[League Shop]

2. MAZE FOR LEAGUE - ‘LEGION INVADER’

[Entry Requirements]
- Above Lv. 55 can enter.
- Only the Same League Members are enabled to enter this maze.

[How To Enter]
- The League [Master / Vice Master / Admin] can open the maze at any time of the week.
- It requires 10,000 Zenny (League Fund) to activate the maze.
- The maze can be activated twice a week. It lasts 48 hours after the maze is activated.
- 1 ~ 4 player parties can enter.
- Each member can enter only once when activated.
- For 2 ~ 4 player parties, only the Team Leader can apply for entry to the maze.
- Activation Weekly Reset: Mondays at 01:00 (GMT)
- Unable to activate 30 minutes before the activation weekly reset time and the activated maze will also be closed.

[About Maze]
- The maze runs for a total of 5 minutes only, and it automatically ends after 5 minutes.
- There is a total of 15 phases of monster defeat.
- Enable to gain a score assigned to monsters when defeating monsters.
- No scores on monsters that are automatically killed when the maze ends.
- 'My Score' can be found in league records and the league raid activation button.
- The total score obtained by the league members will be initialized on a weekly basis.
- Enable to use Active/Passive Akashic Records.
- No limit to use Respawn.
- No Item / Zenny / Ether drops. Also, no EXP / SV gains.
- A member who has participated the league raid cannot be expelled or leave from the League until the maze is deactivated.

[Rewards]
- League Raid Coin is the reward. Enable to purchase items with this coin from NPC [Seres].
- The League Raid Reward will be given according to individual clear score. It will be sent to the player's H.E.M.S of [Received] tab.

◆ 2021 October Update Preview

☞ The First Update in October

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/b518dc26b88997686f4f813c9a431f4cf0ca4b78.png

▶ Corrupted Record: Iris Yuma & Jin Seipatsu

[Corrupted Record: Synopsis]
Iris Yuma, a woman who left people behind. 
Jin Seipatsu, a man who stays to protect people. 
A tale of betrayal and malice has been silently continued in ruined camp.
How powerful the energy of Desire is, leading people to such hell, and everything got messed up by what?

Hello, this is an announcement from SoulWorker.

☞ July 1st Update 

▶ Costume Re-packaging System
- A new function of repacking costumes that have been already obtained will be newly added. 
- The package will be tradable or possessed based on being equipped or not when being unpacked. 
 > Assuming that there are costumes possessed:  
 The package will be possessed. All costumes become possessed when reopening it. 
 > Assuming that there are costumes unequipped: 
 The package will be tradable. All costumes become tradable when reopening it. 
 
- All costumes enabled to apply the repackaging system can be sealed infinitely when the new function has been applied to the in-game system.
 > Event costumes, Individual costumes (Example: Wings) will not be repacked.

☞ July 2nd Update
 
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38551250/880ab8ae7cacc0d15a5283623b21e3fd89381278.png

▶ The 9th SoulWorker, Lee Nabi

- The 9th SoulWorker, “Lee Nabi” will be newly added.
 > Class Up and Desire Awakening can be played through the 9th SoulWorker, Lee Nabi.

- Character Synopsis
Everything disappeared in the blink of an eye.
A massive… something… took my house, people important to me, my life and everything around me; 
 it wiped out everything in my life.
I couldn’t save them; I couldn’t rescue them; I didn’t even have the courage to go in after them. 
I was nothing more than a breathing corpse… standing there not being able to do anything.
Unable to move, I stood there crying inside, waiting for someone to rescue me. 

Oh, you poor child, it looks like you've been through so much. 
You don't need to think about anything, my sweet; fall soundly asleep in my arms.
Don't think about how it started or how it ended; I will tell you everything you need to know.
Put away all thoughts while in your little cocoon.
Keep your eyes closed a bit longer, and before you know it, you'll emerge a beautiful butterfly spreading your majestic wings.

[Order of Lord “QuadStella TriSilva”]
Being at the head of Starry Forest League, these “Four Stars and Three Forests” act upon maintaining everything in this world. Their title represents not only Starry Forest League’s but humanity’s safety in them being their stars and forests. Although not many people have sighted them being hidden in the depths of their East Headquarters and taking care of matters within, QuadStella TriSilva have slowly started revealing themselves to the outside world after the release of their 2nd Generation SoulWorkers. Stars represent the protectors of humanity, while Forests represent war heroes of the battlefields.

[Bernard’s Special Missions Unit]
In order to scout the West, SoulWorker “Ain” has changed his name to “Bernard” and has created a “Special Missions Unit” filled with 2nd Generation SoulWorkers under the order of Lords.
They prioritize superior orders before objective reasoning and start investigating SoulWorkers.
“Hero Armor” who calls himself the world’s hero covered in steel armor along with
“Varbir” who deems himself a savior of the world, spreading peace unto everyone
And many other 2nd Generation SoulWorkers with their own morals go on an adventure together.

[2nd Generation SoulWorkers]
2nd Generation SoulWorkers have been trained for ten years by the Headquarters of Starry Forest League to become as strong and as similar to real SoulWorkers. While they are capable of performing as much Energy as real SoulWorkers for but a moment, unlike real SoulWorkers who perform infinite Soul Energy without any limitations, they become exhausted, feeling fatigued and hunger after a few battles due to Soul Energy consumption; they must rejuvenate themselves through rest and food. What Starry Forest League decides to create the 2nd generation..  


Please look forward to our July Update.
Thank you.

※ The scheduled update may be subject to change due to internal circumstances.
